niche: a state air agency's 2026 press VOC inventory of fourteen printing and converting plants in an ozone nonattainment area, conformed from the plants' information-request returns (ink and coating purchases with their safety data sheets, press logs, oxidizer data-historian exports, capture determinations and oxidizer performance tests), to name the plants a new rule covers from 2027 at 25 tons of 2026 press VOC
answer: Rule 18-4 covers Ashcombe Flexible Packaging (29 tons), Carrow Gravure (37), Kelvedon Laminates (28), Merrion Flexibles (31) and Ravensbrook Gravure Packaging (56); Larkmoor Graphics is the nearest below at 21 tons, 4 short.

analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms every ink, coating and solvent purchase to pounds of VOC from its safety data sheet, every press log to daily VOC used, applies each plant's capture determination, reads the rule and the information request correctly and applies each plant's oxidizer performance test destruction efficiency (the latest, or the mean of its tests) to its 2026 captured VOC names Carrow Gravure, Merrion Flexibles and Ravensbrook Gravure Packaging; only each operating day's oxidizer outlet read from the outlet-against-inlet relation the plants' tests trace (an outlet that holds near a floor concentration however dilute the inlet), at the inlet that day's captured VOC and the oxidizer's airflow imply, adds Ashcombe Flexible Packaging and Kelvedon Laminates.
domain_test: Stationary-source VOC inventory work: an add-on oxidizer's destruction efficiency is measured in a performance test run at maximum production, and a thermal oxidizer's outlet holds near a floor concentration whatever its inlet, so the share it destroys falls as its inlet grows dilute; a plant whose oxidizer fan draws its full air while the presses run at part production feeds the oxidizer a dilute inlet on most days, so the year's controlled VOC needs each day's inlet put through the outlet relation the tests trace; with hospital or traffic nouns there is no oxidizer, no outlet floor and no dilution of a control device's inlet, so nothing is left to decide.

driver: The decisive quantity is each unit's period total of an output that leaves through a removal device whose outlet holds near a floor concentration, so the share the device removes falls as its inlet grows dilute; each device's removal is measured in tests run at the unit's maximum rate, and on the days the unit runs below it the device's fan still draws its full air, so the inlet is dilute and the device removes less than its test shows; applying a test's removal across the period overstates the removal at every unit whose days ran dilute, while the tests across all the devices trace the outlet against the inlet, and each day's inlet, built from the day's throughput and air, carries the removal to the day.
driver_concrete: Each plant's 2026 press VOC is its uncaptured VOC plus what its oxidizer lets through; a regenerative thermal oxidizer's outlet holds near a floor of VOC per cubic foot however dilute its inlet, so its destruction falls from about 98 per cent at a concentrated inlet to the low 90s and below at a dilute one; every performance test ran at maximum production, while the flexographic and laminating plants with fixed-speed oxidizer fans ran most 2026 days well below it with the fan drawing full air, so Ashcombe Flexible Packaging and Kelvedon Laminates, under 25 tons on their tests' efficiencies, cross it once each day's outlet is read from the floor.
stump: The default path applies each plant's latest oxidizer test efficiency to its 2026 captured VOC and names Carrow Gravure, Merrion Flexibles and Ravensbrook Gravure Packaging; a thermal oxidizer's outlet holds near a floor (about 45 ppmv as carbon) however dilute its inlet, every test ran at maximum production, and at Ashcombe Flexible Packaging and Kelvedon Laminates the fixed-speed fans drew their full air through days when the presses ran part of their capacity, so the oxidizers destroyed less than their tests show; each production day's outlet read from the relation the ten oxidizers' tests trace, at the inlet the day's captured VOC and airflow imply, carries Ashcombe from 21 to 29 tons and Kelvedon from 20 to 28, and the rule covers five plants.

differentiation.task478: task478 carries each burner's spot test across the year by the heating value of the gas a supplier delivered, a property of the input recorded in the supplier's monthly table; here no input property moves: a control device's outlet holds a floor, so its removal falls on days its own fan dilutes the inlet, set by how many presses ran against a fan that draws its full air
differentiation.task459: task459 reads a plant's input-to-output ratio at its contract output along its own operating curve; here no unit's own efficiency curve is read at a level: a shared control device removes a share set by its inlet concentration, the joint result of the day's throughput and the fan's drive, through an outlet floor the tests trace across devices
differentiation.task263: task263 unmixes entry-point samples blended from the wells pumping at collection; here nothing is unmixed: one device's outlet is read from its inlet through a floor relation and summed by day
differentiation.task464: task464 counts units below a cut on a new instrument where a regression shrinks predictions; here nothing is predicted across instruments: a measured removal is carried from test conditions to each day's dilution
